faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Transparent answers on source code ownership, delivery timelines, payment options, and ongoing support.

items.question: Do I receive the complete source code?
items.answer: Yes, you own the complete codebase. Everything is delivered via a private Git repository containing the full Frontend, Backend, database schemas, and setup documentation with zero proprietary lock-in.

items.question: How long does it take to deliver a custom project?
items.answer: Timelines depend on the selected tier and scope. Each plan lists its estimated delivery in days, including domain configuration, cloud deployment, and end-to-end QA before handover.

items.question: Which payment methods are supported?
items.answer: We support flexible payment options including Vodafone Cash, InstaPay, Fawry, and bank cards through supported payment gateways.

items.question: Do you provide post-delivery technical support?
items.answer: Yes. Projects include a complimentary post-delivery guarantee window to ensure smooth production stability, with optional ongoing maintenance plans.

items.question: Can new features be added later as my business grows?
items.answer: Absolutely. Every project follows a clean, modular structure so you can easily add new capabilities later—either with ByteCraft or with your own engineering team.
